sources.title: Tiny Transformer
sources.snippet: Tiny Transformer This repository contains an implementation of a simple GPT-like transformer model that can be trained on a single consumer-grade GPU. The code mostly follows along with the videos Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out. and Building Makemore by Andrej Karpathy.

sources.snippet: README Tiny-gpt-from-scratch "My implementation of a Tiny GPT transformer from scratch using PyTorch." 🚀 Tiny GPT: Transformer Model Built From Scratch A minimal GPT-like model implemented using PyTorch This project is my hands-on implementation of a Tiny GPT Transformer, inspired by Andrej Karpathy's "Let's Build GPT" tutorial.

sources.title: callumjohnson/tiny-transformer-generation · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Tiny Transformer for Generation Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Tiny Transformer for Generation. The small configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.

sources.title: Transformers in Machine Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Transformer is a neural network architecture used for various machine learning tasks, especially in natural language processing and computer vision. It focuses on understanding relationships within data to process information more effectively.
